Categories.Title: Getting started
Categories.Description: Small, complete maps that show the basics: a source schema, a target schema, a map and a sample to run it on.

Categories.Title: Loops and conditions
Categories.Description: Maps that repeat over lists, sort and filter them, and only write parts of the output when a condition holds.

Categories.Title: Working with variables
Categories.Description: Maps that keep values in map variables while they run, for totals, counters and values used in more than one place.

Categories.Title: Advanced
Categories.Description: Larger maps with loops, conditions, variables and custom functions, for users who know the editor.

Samples.Title: Customer to contact
Samples.Description: Turns a CRM customer (XML) into an address-book contact (XML). Copies values, writes a fixed value, joins first and last name, lower-cases the e-mail address and looks up whether the customer is active.

Samples.Title: Product feed to shop catalog
Samples.Description: Loads a supplier's product feed (JSON) into a web shop catalog (JSON). Loops over the products and their colors, writes prices and stock as numbers, works out whether each product is in stock and counts the products.

Samples.Title: Web order to pick list
Samples.Description: Turns a web shop order (JSON) into a warehouse pick list (XML). Leaves out digital products, sorts the picks by warehouse location, gives express orders a high priority and only adds gift wrapping when the customer asked for it.

Samples.Title: Purchase order to sales order
Samples.Description: Turns an XML purchase order into a JSON sales order, using the variables lineTotal and orderTotal to add up the line and order totals. Includes an example purchase order to test the map with.

Samples.Title: Timesheets to payroll summary
Samples.Description: Summarises a week of loose time entries (XML) per employee for payroll (XML). Groups the entries by employee and by project, adds up the hours, splits them into regular hours and overtime above 40, and totals the overtime across everyone.
